notes: BREADCRUMB RETRACE. explore's blind fallback tries four headings and, if all four are refused, sleeps 300 ms WITHOUT MOVING -- so the next pass stands on the same block and refuses identically. blindstep-01 added a fifth candidate `ang + PI` and called it 'the line the bot just walked'. THAT WAS FALSE and a Codex pass proved it after deploy: `ang` is an exploration bearing that is RANDOM when the target is near (skills.mjs:3497), the turn is random too (:3536), `ang` is MUTATED on any successful candidate (:3590) so after one perpendicular step the 'reverse' reverses the new heading, and the planner computes its goal at (cos,sin) while the walk goes (-sin,-cos) -- 90 deg apart. Nothing recorded where the bot had been. SO THERE IS NOW A TRAIL: index.mjs's existing 1 Hz sampler keeps up to 8 breadcrumbs, one a second, 2+ blocks apart, ONLY from positions where the bot is onGround and not in water or lava, cleared on death. `retraceHeading` aims at the NEWEST crumb >= 3 blocks away using atan2(-dx,-dz) -- the physics convention, tested on all four axes, because stepLineSafe's first version used +cos and sampled the line BEHIND the bot. No trail means NO fifth candidate. NO SAFETY BOUND IS TOUCHED. The retrace runs the same stepLineSafe at the same maxDrop=3 and the same death-site check as every other candidate. Measured 2026-09-25: 91.5% of refusals inside boxed episodes are drops and only 2.6% of boxed bots are sealed, so a drop bound IS the binding constraint -- but the REVERSE is the worst direction to loosen (its own drop is <=6 in 27.9% of reached reverses against 47.5% for the best forward candidate, median 8 vs 5), and the one death that touched the bound was blindstep-01's 37-block fall where a bound of 6 would have admitted a blind 1.2 s walk over a 6-block drop at a cliff edge. Bound-5-on-all-candidates is a SEPARATE question, put to the owner, because it trades fall damage for escapes. AND IT MEASURES THE ESCAPE, NOT THE INTENTION. blindstep-01 logged its candidate BEFORE the walk, so its exposure floor counted times the candidate was SELECTED and could have been met with no bot moving. `explore_blind_step_retrace` is emitted AFTER the walk and carries real displacement; success means >= 1 block. Branch blindstep-02, sha 1f127db = 9b572aa + the bots/src change (14dd334) + this read and registration; bots/ is byte-identical between 14dd334 and a7d2472, verified by git diff, so the tip is declared to keep the label and the deploy the same thing. npm test 197/197; retrace tests 9/9; 4/4 mutants killed outside src (convention inverted, minDist skip removed, absent trail randomised, oldest-crumb-first).

draw_exposure.note: THE FIRST REGISTRATION EVER TO USE THIS INTERLOCK, and blindstep-01 is why. Its registration declared no draw_exposure, so drawrec.sh fell back to its one hard-coded entombed/marooned filter -- written for recovery-ladder-01 and blind to everything else -- and drew board-d, hive-b, placebo-a, hive-c: THREE OF THE FOUR WEAKEST POOLS for this behaviour. Measured per-pool boxed episodes/bot-h span 80x (hive-a 3.20, board-b 3.07 against board-d 0.04). 150 drop-refusal rows in 6 h cleanly separates the strong pools (~380 rows) from the weak (~5).

exposure.note: Times the retrace was REACHED, counted from a row emitted AFTER the walk, so it is an outcome and not an intention. At the drawn arm's measured ~3.1 boxed episodes/bot-h over 20 bots, 40 is reached inside the first hour; blindstep-01 got 70 reached over 5.8 h on a bad draw, so this is a floor and not a target.

own_lines.note: _explore_blind_step_retrace CANNOT EXIST on the baseline 9b572aa: it is a new logEvent kind AND the baseline keeps no breadcrumb trail to reach it. A nonzero control count means the deploy leaked. evidence=defect is the honest class -- a presence test against a structurally empty baseline, not a statistical claim.

Retrace rows in the canary ARM carrying the BASELINE build. blindstep-01's first 8 canary-arm refusals carried 9b572aa because the bots had not restarted yet, and their 4+4 burst shape would have read as 'the fix is inert' if the pool label had been trusted instead of the build stamped on the row. Nonzero here means the arms are not what the read thinks they are.

primary.note: escaped / reached, a BINOMIAL, against blindstep-01's MEASURED 9 of 70 = 12.9% for the random reverse. Read by a human with its Wilson interval, not by the gate. SAID BEFORE THE READ: there is no contemporaneous control rate -- the baseline cannot emit this row at all -- so this is a historical comparator and the DECIDING lines are the two linkage ones. A freed-episode PRODUCTIVITY claim is NOT on offer: measured yield for any version of this is 0.1-0.4 freed episodes/bot-h against a boxed-share DiD whose own null is sd 8.2 pp. INCONCLUSIVE is the honest close for anything but the mechanism rate.
